title: Vegan Apricot Fideua
description: A twist on traditional Spanish fideua, this vegan version replaces seafood with sweet and tangy apricots.
instructions: Bring the vegan vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the fideua pasta and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the zesty Spanish rice and cook until lightly toasted.
Add the apricots to the pan and stir to combine.
Once the pasta is cooked, drain and add to the pan with the apricot mixture.
Toss to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
